idea: One rainy December dusk in the living room of a 1958 Portland mid-century ranch, shot from one locked frame, cycling through 9 fireplace-wall layouts from a plain plaster wall with a linear fireplace to a sage zellige fireplace flanked by lit fir bookcases.
